SELECT DISTINCT ON (qr.symbol) 
    qr.symbol, 
    qr.revenue, 
    qa.growth_yoy_revenue_pct,

sql_templates.description: Retrieve the latest 10 signals from the past week that either hit targets or stop losses.
sql_templates.query:
SELECT 
  s.symbol, 
  s.signal, 
  s.date_issued, 
  s.hit_target, 
  s.hit_stop, 
  s.return_pct
FROM 
  signals.signal_log s
WHERE 
  s.date_issued >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 week'
  AND (s.hit_target = true OR s.hit_stop = true)
ORDER BY 
  s.date_issued DESC
LIMIT 10;
